prompt:
SUBJECT
O cana. This is the single focal point of the image and every other choice below exists to serve it. Render it prominently, unambiguously and in full — no part of the main subject is cropped away or hidden behind other elements.

SETTING
Placed in simplified setting with clear separation between subject and background. The environment supports the subject and never competes with it for attention; secondary elements stay subordinate in contrast and detail.

COMPOSITION
Centred symmetrical composition with strong vertical axis and balanced margins. The frame is balanced and intentional, with a clear reading order from the primary subject outward.

CAMERA
Close shot on the most telling detail, shot on 50mm at f/2.8, natural perspective. Perspective is natural and undistorted, with the plane of focus falling exactly on the subject.

LIGHTING
Dramatic side light with deep shadows and shaped highlights. A single coherent light direction governs the whole frame; highlights are shaped rather than blown out and shadows retain detail.

COLOUR AND MOOD
Restrained palette of forest green, charcoal and bone, with weathered brass as the only warm note. The overall mood is warm, intimate and reassuring, carried by the light and the colour relationships rather than by added effects.

STYLE
Cinematic still with deliberate colour grading. The stylistic treatment stays consistent across the entire image, with no mixing of incompatible rendering approaches.

DETAIL
Clean, almost clinical rendering where every surface is described precisely and nothing is suggested. Every element in frame is there for a reason.

TECHNICAL
Photorealistic, ultra-detailed, sharp focus on the subject, natural depth of field, 8K resolution, professional colour grading.

ADDITIONAL DIRECTION
Coherent single light direction across the whole image.

COHERENCE
Every element in the frame is physically plausible: scale relationships hold, shadows fall consistently with the stated light direction, reflections match their sources, and materials behave the way real materials behave under this light.

observatii: Flux urmărește bine limbajul natural descriptiv; păstrează frazele complete.
